title: Audit QQ16 high-count scratch and exact installation costs
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The QQ16 Context lifecycle handoff leaves the numerical `new_context` producer separate from finite-handle restoration. This package proves and checks one exact part of that producer: the temporary high count uses **exactly two simultaneous scratch Tape leases**, and its installation into the fixed `highs` role has a complete source/destination operation bill.

For `M=q^w`, the inherited count is `H=q^((w-1)d^2)`. With `n=bit_length(H)+1` (including RIGHT) and an old destination body of length D, the literal `save_count` path costs `7n+2D+10` reads, `2n+D` writes and `6n+2D+14` unit moves. The written loop proof covers the stated parameter domain; finite tests corroborate it. The actual recursive caller parks streams before construction, giving D=0.

This is a scoped source audit, not a new count formula, full constructor tariff, supplier or kappa improvement. Numerical-word production, pool-selection/control cost, backing storage, metadata compilation, complete parent parking and the full F(K)/D* versus B* comparison remain open. The source loader and complete Ordinary/controller are not replayed. Only this five-file package is added.

## Task and overlap

Base: canonical main `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`; priority revision 7. Contribution: `5ac02c05ad29f4b136cab8fb787985a1ea64de80`. Task `joint-query-controller`, refined to one numerical-producer obligation.

[Canonical investigation and scope correction](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4744#discussioncomment-19152915). The complete overlap refresh revealed an earlier concurrent `restore_context` claim, so this work moved to its explicitly excluded numerical producer. [PR5034](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5034) supplies the graph cap; [PR5330](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5330) supplies adoption and the open constructor question. R437 descendant ingress already reaches `new_context`; the delta here is its exact scratch/installation audit.

All live source inputs are pinned at the base commit. The algorithms are taken from the retained PR2809 nested archive inside `research/physical-gaussian-leaf/inputs/pr3087.tar`, without editing that archive. Latest overlap covers 307 open PRs, 4,638 Discussion records and all 7,267 tracked top-level notes, with complete reported pagination. Historical diffs and unpublished work are outside coverage. Refreshed main has no relevant source/guidance changes.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.0 on Windows; standard library only.

- Registered normal and optimized replay pass: **82 cases**, three executed rejection controls and three arithmetic discriminators. Each case checks canonical values, aliases, scratch cleanup, dirty spectators, exact operation counts, ended-lease reuse and owned cleanup.
- Discriminating witness: q=3, w=2, d=2, D=0 gives H=81 and exactly **66 reads, 16 writes, 62 moves**. The largest tested Count has 203 value bits.
- Metadata/source pins and all eight committed package/input byte checks pass. The official export integrity check passes.
- Both isolated Git-free export replays pass, all nine exported files remain byte-identical, and a corrupted source archive is rejected in both modes.
- Selected source-binding orientation passes; no selected native cold replay, Lean, Docker or whole-controller run. The optional full-history preflight was not run in this shallow checkout; every declared source pin is at the direct parent base.

Reproduce:

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-high-count-installation --check-only
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-high-count-installation
```

Credit Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's PR2753/PR2769/PR2809 caller/cardinality/pool/parking sources, JoyboyBrian's PR5034/PR5330 and handoff, Chris R/Clear1nsight, Tekalign, ywz65, Mihir Srivastava and the retained QQ16/control lineage. The count formula and source implementation are inherited. The new contribution is the scoped proof, exact meter decomposition and source-bound verification.

Prepared by Mihir Srivastava with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. No independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Open next questions

The package README/TASK name two bounded follow-ups: price the reached `radix_power/divmod` numerical-word loops, and compose the producer with finite-handle restoration and the real parent parking protocol. Those costs are required before claiming a complete constructor or caller advantage.
